original_prompt: Generate an Ansible playbook that installs and configures the Prometheus node_exporter (binary install, systemd service) on a Linux host listening on port 9100.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Generate an Ansible playbook that installs and configures the Prometheus node_exporter (binary install, systemd service) on a Linux host listening on port 9100.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Install and configure Prometheus node_exporter
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    node_exporter_version: "1.7.0"
    node_exporter_arch_map:
      x86_64: amd64
      aarch64: arm64
    node_exporter_arch: "{{ node_exporter_arch_map[ansible_architecture] | default(ansible_architecture) }}"
    node_exporter_checksum: "sha256:5a4a9fbfaa6aa6b3b3a4f6e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5e5"
  tasks:
    - name: Create node_exporter system group
      group:
        name: node_exporter
        system: true

    - name: Create node_exporter system user
      user:
        name: node_exporter
        system: true
        shell: /sbin/nologin
        group: node_exporter
        home: /var/lib/node_exporter

    - name: Download node_exporter binary
      get_url:
        url: "https://github.com/prometheus/node_exporter/releases/download/v{{ node_exporter_version }}/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.linux-{{ node_exporter_arch }}.tar.gz"
        dest: "/tmp/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.linux-{{ node_exporter_arch }}.tar.gz"
        checksum: "{{ node_exporter_checksum }}"
        mode: "0644"
        owner: root
        group: root

    - name: Extract node_exporter binary
      unarchive:
        src: "/tmp/node_exporter-{{ node_exporter_version }}.linux-{{ node_exporter_arch }}.tar.gz"
        dest: /usr/local/bin
        remote_src: true
        extra_opts:
          - --strip-components=1
          - --wildcards
          - "*/node_exporter"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Create systemd service unit
      copy:
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/node_exporter.service
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=Prometheus Node Exporter
          After=network-online.target
          Wants=network-online.target

          [Service]
          User=node_exporter
          Group=node_exporter
          Type=simple
          ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/node_exporter --web.listen-address=:9100
          Restart=always
          RestartSec=5
          PrivateTmp=true
          NoNewPrivileges=true
          ProtectSystem=strict
          ProtectHome=true

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target

    - name: Reload systemd daemon
      systemd:
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Enable and start node_exporter service
      systemd:
        name: node_exporter
        state: started
        enabled: true
